title: Vesper Crossroads - Four-Way Nexus
_note: Hub relit late-game variant (post hub_unlocked). The sleepy fork now a bustling crossroads. gbc 4-voice band. 116 BPM, 4/4, bright C major. Vesper motif stated brighter/busier, now harmonised by a counter-line (in the lead's own phrasing) - the home-base motif 'grown up'. lead=pulse25 confident fuller, small answering counter-phrase. harmony=busier ascending-sparkle bell arps (Light signature). bass=walking eighths, propulsive. drums=fuller kick/snare/hat + fill at the seam. 24-bar loop. Last bar G(V) dom -> resolves to C bar 1.
